'''Virmeude Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], that was located on the world [[Virmeude]]. It was operated by the [[Issham Mining Corporation]], a front company for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Description==
The Starport was located deep beneath the frozen bedrock of Virmeude. It operated standard spaceport facilities, catering for Alliance ships only. It was often frequented by [[Rebel privateer]]s and Alliance [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
